subject: math

items.prompt:
Volume is measured in
A) cubic units
B) square units
C) units long
D) minutes

A box filled with $8$ unit cubes has volume
A) $8$ cubic units
B) $8$ square units
C) $4$ cubic units
D) $8$ units

Volume measures the space a solid
A) takes up
B) covers flatly
C) weighs
D) costs

A single unit cube has a volume of
A) $1$ cubic unit
B) $6$ cubic units
C) $0$
D) $1$ square unit

A solid of $12$ unit cubes has volume
A) $12$ cubic units
B) $6$ cubic units
C) $24$ cubic units
D) $12$ square units

Why no gaps when filling with cubes?
A) So the volume count is correct
B) To use more cubes
C) To make it bigger
D) No reason
items.answer: A) So the volume count is correct
